articles.headline: OPEC+ Agrees To Raise Output Even as Hormuz Shipping Security Remains Uncertain
articles.summary: OPEC+ members agreed to raise their collective oil‑production quotas from August even as crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz remain uncertain.
articles._summary: OPEC+ members agreed to raise their collective oil‑production quotas from August even as crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz remain uncertain. Seven nations led by Saudi Arabia and Russia will add 188,000 barrels per day to their August output target, OPEC said Sunday. Ministers from Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman approved the adjustment during virtual talks on Sunday. "The countries will continue to closely monitor and assess market conditions," OPEC said. "They reaffirmed the importance of adopting a cautious approach and retaining full flexibility to increase." The decision follows months of conflict‑driven disruption to Hormuz that pushed regional output to historic lows, forcing producers to build large inventories. The strait handles roughly a fifth of global oil flows and has remained a flashpoint between Washington and Tehran.

articles._zh_summary: 尽管通过霍尔木兹海峡的原油运输仍存在不确定性，但 OPEC+ 成员国同意从 8 月起提高集体石油生产配额。欧佩克周日表示，以沙特阿拉伯和俄罗斯为首的七个国家将在其 8 月份产量目标的基础上增加 188,000 桶/日。沙特阿拉伯、俄罗斯、伊拉克、科威特、哈萨克斯坦、阿尔及利亚和阿曼的部长在周日的虚拟会谈中批准了这一调整。 “各国将继续密切监测和评估市场状况，”欧佩克表示。 “他们重申了采取谨慎态度并保留充分灵活性来增加的重要性。”这一决定是在霍尔木兹地区因冲突而中断数月之后做出的，该地区的产量降至历史低点，迫使生产商建立大量库存。该海峡处理着全球大约五分之一的石油流量，并且仍然是华盛顿和德黑兰之间的热点。

articles.headline: Iran's supreme leader absent as senior officials attend ayatollah's funeral
articles.summary: Mojtaba Khamenei has not been seen in public since the attack which killed his father at the onset of the US-Israel war with Iran.
articles._summary: Leaders including Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian were in attendance for the former supreme leader's funeral, but Mojtaba Khamenei was absent Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei was conspicuously absent from his father's funeral, as senior regime figures joined thousands paying their respects to the late ayatollah on Sunday. Ali Khamenei's other three sons - Masoud, Mostafa and Meysam - all attended the service on Sunday, alongside officials including President Masoud Pezeshkian and Revolutionary Guards chief Ahmad Vahidi. Speculation about Mojtaba's condition - fuelled by rumours he was wounded in the same US-Israel air strikes that killed his father - has continued as he has not appeared in public since his appointment in early March. The elder Khamenei ruled the Islamic republic from 1989 until his death in February. Official funeral proceedings for late supreme leader began on Friday, with events planned across Iran and Iraq over the coming week.

articles.headline: US marks 250th birthday with fireworks, flyovers and extreme weather
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump's speech included some of his political agenda but also honoured war veterans and American history.
articles._summary: Scorching heat and delays: How Washington DC marked US' 250th birthday The US has marked its 250th birthday with fireworks and flyovers - but celebrations across the country were complicated by extreme weather. "The American dream is back," US President Donald Trump told a cheering crowd during a delayed rally in Washington's National Mall, before what he described as the world's largest firework display. The 4 July federal holiday commemorates the 13 US colonies signing the Declaration of Independence in 1776 to end British rule. Despite the celebrations, Trump has been criticised for making himself central to the milestone and politicising the celebrations. The president's speech, which wrapped up just before midnight, touched on political themes including the rejection of communism, his backing of the Save America Act and the right to bear arms.

articles.headline: Trump Offers to Help Broker Ukraine Peace Deal in Nearly 90-Minute Call With Putin
articles.summary: Trump offered to help broker a resolution to the Ukraine war during a nearly 90-minute call with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Saturday.
articles._summary: President Donald Trump offered to help broker a resolution to the Ukraine war during a nearly 90-minute call with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Saturday. According to a statement released early Sunday by Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov , the conversation was “business-like and quite constructive.” Russia said it is seeking a political and diplomatic settlement based on its “fundamental approach.” Ushakov accused Kyiv and its European allies of escalating the conflict through long-range strikes on Russian oil infrastructure. He said Putin described the battlefield situation, claiming Russian forces are “confidently advancing, liberating one locality after another.” Russia said on Saturday that it had taken control of Kostiantynivka, an important industrial city in Ukraine’s Donetsk region known for its glassmaking industry. Ukraine has denied this claim.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普在与普京近 90 分钟的通话中表示愿意帮助斡旋者达成乌克兰和平协议
articles._zh_summary: 周六，唐纳德·特朗普总统与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行了近 90 分钟的通话，表示愿意帮助调解乌克兰战争的解决方案。根据克里姆林宫助手尤里·乌沙科夫周日早些时候发表的一份声明，这次谈话“很务实，而且很有建设性”。俄罗斯表示，正在寻求基于其“基本方针”的政治和外交解决方案。乌沙科夫指责基辅及其欧洲盟友通过对俄罗斯石油基础设施的远程打击使冲突升级。他说，普京描述了战场局势，声称俄罗斯军队“正在自信地前进，解放一个又一个地方”。俄罗斯周六表示，它已经控制了科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡，这是乌克兰顿涅茨克地区的一个重要工业城市，以玻璃制造工业而闻名。乌克兰否认了这一说法。

articles.headline: Ukraine hits major oil terminal in Russia's St Petersburg
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky says the target is key infrastructure "that generates revenue for Russia's war".
articles._summary: Ukraine's military described St Petersburg's oil terminal as "one of the largest" in Russia A major oil terminal in Russia's second city of St Petersburg in the north-west was struck overnight by Ukraine, President Volodymyr Zelensky has said. He described it as key "infrastructure that generates revenue for Russia's war". Ukraine also said a major Russian naval base in the region was hit. St Petersburg Governor Aleksandr Beglov said the city was under a "massive" drone attack, admitting the oil terminal was hit. He reported no casualties. Ukraine has recently intensified its long-range drone attacks on Russia's critical energy infrastructure, causing widespread fuel shortages. Kyiv says nearly 43% of Russia's oil refining capacity has been "disabled" as a result. Ukraine says Russian oil and gas facilities are legitimate targets as Moscow relies heavily on fossil fuel exports to continue its war effort.
articles._zh_headline: 乌克兰袭击俄罗斯圣彼得堡主要石油码头
